units.source_text: 庭前几树红梅，香色都甚可爱。

en.t: Several red plum trees stood before the garden, lovely in both fragrance and color.

units.source_text: 黄莺也不忍飞过，频频啼啭。

en.t: Even the yellow orioles could not bear to fly past, and kept singing again and again.

units.source_text: 何况悲叹“春犹昔日春”的两人的谈话，在这时候异常凄凉。

en.t: Still more sorrowful, at such a time, was the conversation of the two who lamented, "Spring is still the spring of former days."

units.source_text: 春风吹入室内，花香和贵客的衣香虽非柑橘之香，亦可令人追念往昔。

en.t: The spring breeze blew into the room, and though the fragrance of the blossoms and the noble guest's robes was not the scent of citrus, it still made one remember the past.

units.source_text: 二女公子回忆姐姐在世之时，为欲消遣岑寂，为欲安慰忧辛，常常专心一意地赏玩红梅。

en.t: The two young ladies remembered how, when their elder sister was alive, she would often gaze intently at the red plum blossoms to distract herself from loneliness and soothe her sorrows.

units.source_text: 不堪追慕之情，遂吟诗曰：

en.t: Unable to bear their longing for her, they then composed a poem:
